proposed.explanation: Tikal's Temple IV reached 65 meters but was not a double pyramid with Tlaloc/Huitzilopochtli dedication. Kukulkan Pyramid at Chichen Itza rose ~30 meters, not 60, and was not dual-deity dedicated. Temple of Inscriptions at Palenque served burial functions, not the cosmological duality described. The Templo Mayor (Tenochtitlan, present-day Mexico City, construction circa 1375–1521 CE) was a double pyramid—two temple summits crowning a shared stone base—dedicated to the rain god Tlaloc (north) and the war god Huitzilopochtli (south)...rose approximately 60 meters in its final form, with multiple reconstruction phases visible in excavations.'
